candidate_workaround: Use the exact option declared by each Method Flow subcommand: record for methods and witness-file for witnesses.
failure_signature: The Method Flow runner refuses a witness invocation because a method-record option was supplied.
recurrence_guard: Check the exact subcommand argument contract before every Method Flow runner invocation.
rollback: Retain the refused invocation, grant it zero witness credit, and leave the ledger otherwise unchanged.
scope_boundary: Owner-local Method Flow invocation recovery only; no x2, canonical-final, or independent-reproduction credit.
title: Use exact Method Flow subcommand argument contracts
trigger_preconditions: A Method Flow runner subcommand has a command-specific file option.
